name: Arthur Woods
source:
Occupation: Hired Assassin
Notable Traits: Trained by an Ex-SAS, accurate, deadly

A man so consumed with anger, he plunged himself into the dark world of assassination. Trained by an ex-SAS, he sharpened himself into a deadly killer in just two years by his sheer will.

Ruthless, cold, and egotistical. Those words describe him perfectly. A result-oriented person, he is willing to use any and all methods to achieve his goals.

Haunted by the death of his girlfriend, he seeks revenge against The Syndicate, even though deep down he knows that revenge is futile.

[Edited from [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/716330/VOID/]Steam[/url] and [url=http://void.vifthfloor.moe/img/arthur.png]Character Profile[/url]]
